mapper.sql: SELECT f.config, ans.value FROM fields f LEFT JOIN answers ans ON ans.space_id = f.space_id AND ans.event_id = f.event_id AND ans.field_id = f.id AND ans.application_id = app.id WHERE f.space_id = p.space_id AND f.event_id = p.event_id AND f.form_id = app.form_id AND f.${column} = '${key}' AND NOT f.hidden LIMIT 1
SELECT a.id, a.form_id FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC, a.id LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT version FROM room_boards WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}

INSERT INTO room_boards (space_id, event_id, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{eventId}, 1, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (space_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET version = room_boards.version + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at RETURNING version
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rooms WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND name = #{name} AND id <> #{roomId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rooms ( id, space_id, event_id, name, location_note, capacity, gender_option_id, sort_order, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{name}, #{locationNote}, #{capacity}, #{genderOptionId}, (SELECT coalesce(max(sort_order) + 1, 0) FROM rooms WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}), 0, #{actorUserId}, #{at}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE rooms SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{roomId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM room_assignments WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND room_id = #{roomId}
DELETE FROM rooms WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT participant_id FROM room_assignments WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND night = 0 ORDER BY participant_id

SELECT f.config::text FROM forms fo JOIN fields f ON f.space_id = fo.space_id AND f.event_id = fo.event_id AND f.form_id = fo.id WHERE fo.space_id = #{spaceId} AND fo.event_id = #{eventId} AND f.preset_key = 'GENDER' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_assignments ( space_id, event_id, participant_id, night, room_id, basis, basis_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES ( #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{participantId}, 0, #{roomId}, CAST(#{basis} AS jsonb), #{at}, #{actorUserId}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (space_id, event_id, participant_id, night) DO UPDATE SET room_id = excluded.room_id, basis = excluded.basis, basis_at = excluded.basis_at, updated_by = excluded.updated_by, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO room_assignment_logs ( id, space_id, event_id, participant_id, night, from_room_id, to_room_id, cause, actor_user_id, created_at) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{participantId}, 0, #{fromRoomId}, #{toRoomId}, #{cause}, #{actorUserId}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT participant_id FROM room_assignment_logs WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND cause = 'WITHDRAWN' AND created_at >= #{at}

SELECT rp.id AS publication_id, rp.board_version, rp.snapshot::text AS snapshot, rp.published_at, u.display_name AS published_by_display_name FROM room_publications rp JOIN users u ON u.id = rp.published_by WHERE rp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND rp.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY rp.seq DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_publications WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_publications ( id, space_id, event_id, board_version, snapshot, published_by, published_at) VALUES ( #{publicationId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{boardVersion}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb), #{actorUserId}, #{at})
